faqs.a:
Section 101.3. Intent,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
101.3. Intent.
This code shall be construed to secure its expressed intent, which is to ensure public
                  health, safety and welfare insofar as they are affected by the continued occupancy
                  and maintenance of structures and premises. Existing structures and premises that
                  do not comply with these provisions shall be altered or repaired to provide a minimum
                  level of health and safety as required herein. A structure or premise shall not be
                  considered in violation of this code if such structure or premise complied with applicable
                  codes at the time of construction or alteration unless maintenance is required for
                  health and safety issues."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
